label: login-roblox.vercel.app
reasons: Domain 'login-roblox' and repo 'login.roblox' impersonate Roblox, a real gaming platform where visitors have accounts
The entire page is double-encoded via document.write(unescape(...)) — a technique to hide the actual content from scanners while delivering a phishing page
The obfuscated payload resolves to a login form on a page impersonating Roblox's authentication system, designed to harvest visitor credentials
